dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stand behind the counter. After a short while, a customer walks in...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: #Hey there, Boss. That stuff I ordered a few days ago... Huh? {NICKNAME}, Paimon, what are you doing here?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Is there any place you don't have friends? You make even more connections than us escort guards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, that's enough. Now it's Paimon's turn to do the asking — what are you doing in Nod-Krai, Gaming? We're a long way from Liyue.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Oh, well, I happen to know someone out here, and one of their elders has a birthday coming up...

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: The old man doesn't want any fancy presents or a feast or anything — he misses home and just wants to see an authentic Liyue Wushou Dance.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: But both this guy I know and his elderly relative are getting on in years, and there's no way they're making the trip back to Liyue... So they asked me to visit Nod-Krai and put on a performance.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Then, I heard from my escort friends about a job that would take us to Nod-Krai, so I decided to join them.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did you have a safe journey?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: We ran into a few bandits on the way, but we sent 'em packing easily enough. No damage to people or goods!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Anyway, back to business. I was hoping Lady Nefer could put me in touch with some local suppliers — I'm looking to pick up some quality wood.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Once I get some wood, I can start building a stage, and then the performance can begin!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: #Thanks, {NICKNAME}. The next time you're in Liyue, I'll treat you to... Huh? Is someone calling me...?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: #It'll be the other guards out looking for me, sorry, {NICKNAME}, I've gotta go!
